title: A Warranty document links the original work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A on asset 1.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Warranty, closed, with work order 2 as its original work order.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click the original work order's number on the document.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The document block reads "No Charge Work Order [number]".
  • The NO CHARGE stamp shows with "Category: Warranty · Original work order [work order 2's number]".
  • Work order 2's number reads as work order 2 shows it in ShopView (its display number).

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 opens: the number is a link in ShopView.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-R5: “The Finance tab of a closed work order shows the NO CHARGE document: the masthead as on the invoice today (letterhead left, the shop logo in the centre slot, the document block "Internal Work Order [number]" or "No Charge Work Order [number]" with the date right), and under the masthead line, on the left and never over the logo, the INTERNAL or NO CHARGE stamp with the line "Category: [name]" and, when set, "· Original work order [number]" (a link in ShopView, plain on the PDF), Bill to the customer, the asset block, labor lines with hours only, parts lines with quantity and cost only (cost under 'See Financial Data'), a Summary with Parts cost (one number: stock parts plus special orders and sublet, at the amounts of S3-R2, core cost excluded, S2-E7), Shop supplies (when above $0.00) and Labor hours (the labor hours on the lines), and no tax, total, payments, balance or signature block; with Download, Print and Email (the recipient field is empty; the user types the shop's own address or any other; never automatically). The Customer PO field is not required. The internal invoice carries the work order number, as every invoice does today; no number is consumed or skipped. Parts cost on the document and in the report is fixed at Close: a vendor bill entered, edited or deleted after Close posts its own amounts to the work order's expense account (S7-R3) and changes neither the document nor the report. Email uses the invoice email template of today (it carries no amounts) with the subject "Internal Work Order [number]" or "No Charge Work Order [number]".”
  • S2-R16: “A no-charge work order always carries one category from the No Charge list, set at creation (S2-R2) or at conversion (S2-R5) and editable with Change category (S2-R6) until Close. It shows in the Change category dialog, on the NO CHARGE document and the estimate under the masthead ("Category: Warranty", with "· Original work order S2-30455" only when the original is a real work order, never "Not in ShopView"), in the notes and the audit log, in the Internal Work Orders report (S9-R2), in the Customer Invoice export (S9-R6), in the hub record (S8-R1) and in the Open API (S2-R12). It is not shown on the work order detail or in lists; the badge is the only mark there. The category decides the account the parts cost posts to (Stories 5 to 8). Internal work orders carry an Internal category resolved by S2-R1.”
  • S2-R17: “When the category requires the original work order, every dialog that sets the category (New Work Order S2-R2, Convert to No Charge S2-R5, Change category S2-R6, and the line dialogs of Story 12) shows the selects "Original work order" and "Original line" of S2-R2. Both are optional in the dialogs; the original work order is required at Close (S3-R2) and before Create invoice on a no-charge line (S12-R9); "Not in ShopView" satisfies it. The original technicians are derived when saved and stored with the work order or the line: every technician the original line shows, however they were assigned, by hand or from a schedule shift (a line with several technicians gives several, and the comeback counts once for each in the report); without an original line, the technician assigned to the original work order; without one, or with "Not in ShopView", none, and the report shows the job under Unassigned so it stays in the totals. They are shown in the dialog as soon as the original is picked, in the report (S9-R2) and in the hub record (S8-R1). The original work order is a link on the document, in the notes and in the report.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 5331 (TP-679): “Snapshot the original work order's **display** number”
  • Tech plan line 5331 (TP-679): “Otherwise the portal and the documents print”
